title: Named reactions toolkit
examples: When I see a ketone and an aldehyde, what reaction should I think of?
How do I know which reaction to use when I have an aromatic ring?
Can you show me an example of a reaction that uses a Lewis acid?

explain.say: Today we will look at some named reactions in organic chemistry.
The aldol condensation involves the reaction between two carbonyl compounds.
For example, when we mix acetaldehyde with acetone, we get a condensation product.
Next, the Cannizzaro reaction happens with aldehydes that lack alpha hydrogens.
The Friedel-Crafts reactions are used to attach groups to aromatic rings.
In reality, when we synthesize pharmaceuticals, we use these named reactions often.

faq.q: What is the main difference between Aldol and Cannizzaro reactions?
faq.a: Aldol condensation requires alpha hydrogens on the carbonyls to react. The Cannizzaro reaction happens when there are no alpha hydrogens available.
asks: When do I use Aldol versus Cannizzaro?
What condition dictates which reaction occurs?

faq.q: Do I always need a Lewis acid for Friedel-Crafts reactions?
faq.a: Yes, a Lewis acid like aluminum chloride is typically required to activate the electrophile in Friedel-Crafts reactions. This helps the reaction proceed efficiently.
asks: Is a catalyst necessary for F-C?
What role does the Lewis acid play here?

faq.q: Can I perform both Aldol and Cannizzaro reactions on the same molecule?
faq.a: It depends on the structure. If the molecule has both reactive sites, the reaction pathway will favor the one with the best conditions or most acidic proton.
asks: Are there any exceptions to these rules?

faq.q: What kind of compounds are best suited for the Cannizzaro reaction?
faq.a: Aldehydes that lack any hydrogen atoms on the carbon adjacent to the carbonyl group are ideal for the Cannizzaro reaction. Benzaldehyde is a common example.
asks: What must an aldehyde lack for Cannizzaro?

faq.q: What is the role of the solvent in these named reactions?
faq.a: The solvent can sometimes influence the reaction mechanism or stabilize intermediates. Sometimes protic solvents are preferred for aldol reactions.
asks: Can I use water as a solvent here?

facts: Aldol condensation typically requires the presence of a base catalyst.
The Cannizzaro reaction is a disproportionation reaction.
Friedel-Crafts reactions are used to substitute groups on benzene rings.
A Lewis acid is a substance that accepts an electron pair.

quiz.say: If you react benzaldehyde with excess base, which reaction is most likely to occur?
quiz.why: Benzaldehyde has no alpha hydrogens, making it perfect for the Cannizzaro reaction.

wrong.0: This requires at least one alpha hydrogen on a carbonyl group.
wrong.1: This reaction requires an aromatic ring and an acylating agent.
wrong.2: While elimination happens, the specific conditions favor disproportionation.

quiz.say: To attach an acyl group to toluene, which set of reagents is appropriate?
quiz.why: This is the classic Friedel-Crafts acylation, needing an acyl halide and a Lewis acid.

wrong.0: Simple acid addition is insufficient to form the necessary electrophile.
wrong.2: A strong base would likely cause unwanted side reactions or deprotonation.
wrong.3: This is not the correct electrophile source for acylation.

quiz.say: Predict the major product when acetone reacts with formaldehyde under basic conditions.
quiz.why: Both compounds have alpha hydrogens, allowing for the aldol condensation mechanism.

wrong.0: Cannizzaro requires the absence of alpha hydrogens.
wrong.1: The basic conditions promote the enolate formation needed for aldol.
wrong.2: This reaction requires an aromatic ring structure.
